cards.example_en: Heavy rain may delay the school bus this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 大雨可能会让校车今天下午晚点。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：直接的
cards.example_en: Is there a direct train from our town to the capital?
cards.example_zh: 从我们镇到首都有直达火车吗？

cards.example_en: The cough syrup had little effect, so Mum called the clinic.
cards.example_zh: 止咳糖浆几乎没有效果，妈妈就给诊所打了电话。

cards.example_en: The eagle's flight over the valley looked calm and strong.
cards.example_zh: 鹰飞越山谷的飞行看起来平稳而有力。

cards.example_en: Some birds fly across the sea when winter comes.
cards.example_zh: 冬天来的时候，有些鸟会飞过大海。

cards.example_en: Village folk shared a big meal after the harvest.
cards.example_zh: 村里的人们在收获后一起吃了一顿丰盛的饭。

cards.example_en: Teachers changed the format of the weekly spelling quiz.
cards.example_zh: 老师改了每周拼写小测的格式。

cards.example_en: Please stand at the front of the line.
Parents waited outside the gate with coats and umbrellas.
cards.example_zh: 家长们拿着外套和雨伞在大门外等着。

cards.example_en: A girl from Class Two won the city reading prize.
cards.example_zh: 二班的一个女孩获得了全市阅读奖。

cards.example_en: Apples lay on the ground under the tree after the strong wind.
cards.example_zh: 大风过后，苹果落在了树下的地面上。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：手（名词）
cards.example_en: Paint covered his hand after the art lesson ended.
cards.example_zh: 美术课结束后，他满手都是颜料。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：她自己
中考/CEFR 常用词：嗨；你好
cards.example_en: Hi! Are you in this class?
You must show proof of identity.
